name: smwgraphics-nesquik-new-demo-raster-bars
title: NESQuik New Demo - Raster Bars
description:
I ripped this from a demo called 'New Demo' made by a demo group called NESQuik(not to be confused with the milk brand).

This part was specifically ripped from the portion of the demo with a raster effect that repeats 1 scanline across the whole screen, and then changes the vertical position of the background within the scanline to make it look like parallax scrolling due to how the graphics look.

To apply the effect, add the included ASM through UberASM to a level using this background.

Here is video showing the code.
